alt.en: The top of a red sheet-music cover. Small red lettering reads "Dedicated to Mr. W. Nicholson, Corning, N.Y." Below it a white ribbon across a red band reads "Song for Baritone or Bass Voice.", and under that, in tall white letters on red, "Asleep in the Deep".
alt.es: La parte superior de una portada roja de partitura. Unas letras rojas pequeñas dicen "Dedicated to Mr. W. Nicholson, Corning, N.Y." Debajo, una cinta blanca sobre una franja roja dice "Song for Baritone or Bass Voice.", y más abajo, en letras blancas altas sobre fondo rojo, "Asleep in the Deep".

caption.en: The top of the red cover of F. A. Mills's bass edition (copyright 1897): "Song for Baritone or Bass Voice", the way the song was sold to low voices.
caption.es: La parte superior de la portada roja de la edición para bajo de F. A. Mills (copyright 1897): "Song for Baritone or Bass Voice" (canción para voz de barítono o de bajo), así se vendía la canción a las voces graves.

source: Asleep in the Deep, bass solo and male quartette chorus, in D (New York: F. A. Mills, 48 West 29th St.; "Copyright, 1897, by Julie C. Petrie"), cover, detail of the top (the singer's photograph below it is left out)

alt.en: A printed page of music headed "Asleep in the Deep." and "(Bass Solo and Male Quartette Chorus.)", with "Words by Arthur J. Lamb" and "Music by H. W. Petrie". A piano introduction in 12/8 fills three systems; the voice part below, in the bass clef, carries the words "1. Storm-y the night and the waves roll high, Brave-ly the ship doth ride" and "2. What of the storm when the night is o'er, There is no trace or sign!". At the foot: "Copyright, 1897, by Julie C. Petrie. English copyright secured. Published by F. A. Mills, 48 W. 29th St., N. Y."
alt.es: Una página impresa de música con el encabezado "Asleep in the Deep." y "(Bass Solo and Male Quartette Chorus.)", con "Words by Arthur J. Lamb" y "Music by H. W. Petrie". Una introducción de piano en 12/8 ocupa tres sistemas; debajo, la parte vocal, en clave de fa, lleva las palabras "1. Storm-y the night and the waves roll high, Brave-ly the ship doth ride" y "2. What of the storm when the night is o'er, There is no trace or sign!". Al pie: "Copyright, 1897, by Julie C. Petrie. English copyright secured. Published by F. A. Mills, 48 W. 29th St., N. Y."

alt.en: A printed page of music for a bass soloist, a male quartet on two staves, and piano, marked "Solo voice loud. Chorus soft." The solo line sings "Ma-ny brave hearts are a-sleep in the deep, so be-ware! be-ware!", and the quartet answers "Be-ware!". In the last bars the solo line falls to a low note below the bass staff on its final "Be-ware!", held under a pause, while the quartet, marked ppp, sings "Be-ware!" over the closing double bar.
alt.es: Una página impresa de música para bajo solista, cuarteto masculino en dos pentagramas y piano, marcada "Solo voice loud. Chorus soft." La línea solista canta "Ma-ny brave hearts are a-sleep in the deep, so be-ware! be-ware!", y el cuarteto responde "Be-ware!". En los últimos compases la línea solista baja a una nota grave por debajo del pentagrama en su último "Be-ware!", sostenida bajo un calderón, mientras el cuarteto, marcado ppp, canta "Be-ware!" sobre la doble barra final.

caption.en: The last page of the bass edition: the soloist falls from A to the low D below the bass staff, held under a pause, while the quartet sings its last "Beware!" ppp.
caption.es: La última página de la edición para bajo: el solista baja del La al Re grave, por debajo del pentagrama en clave de fa, sostenido bajo un calderón, mientras el cuarteto canta su último "Beware!" ppp.
